title: 三行摘要，两页正文
content:
这是一篇只提供译文的文章：原文较长，卡片上只保留译文与来源信息。

译文的标题和正文都由同一个 `translation` 对象提供，两者都按 Markdown 渲染，因此列表、引用和代码在译文里同样可用。

translation.title: Three-line summary, two pages of body
translation.content:
This article provides only a translation: the original is long, so the card keeps just the translation and the source.

The translated title and body both come from the same `translation` object, and both render as Markdown, so lists, quotes, and code work in the translation too.
